description: Provides Nerd Font filetype icons and colors for Neovim plugins. Used as a dependency by nvim-tree, lualine, telescope, bufferline, and many others.
author: nvim-tree
tagline: Nerd Font filetype icons for Neovim — used by most UI plugins as a dependency

options.label: Color Icons
options.description: Use distinct colors per icon. When disabled, all icons are rendered in the default icon color, giving a uniform monochrome appearance.

options.label: Show Default Icon
options.description: Return a generic fallback icon when no specific icon is found for a file. When disabled, plugins that request an icon for an unknown file type receive nil.

options.label: Strict Lookup
options.description: Use strict icon resolution: check the filename table first, then the extension table separately. Prevents a file with no extension from accidentally matching an extension icon because its name happens to match one.

options.label: Color Variant
options.description: Force a specific light or dark icon color variant, instead of automatically following Neovim's background setting. Leave unset (the default) to let the plugin switch variants automatically when you change between light and dark themes.

options.label: Highlight Blend
options.description: Override the blend value for all icon highlight groups (see :h highlight-blend). Set to 0 to make icons fully opaque — useful if icons look translucent due to the pumblend option. Leave unset (the default) to use Neovim's standard blending.

options.label: Icon Overrides (General)
options.description: Override or add icons by name. Keys are the icon name (e.g. 'zsh', 'lua'). Each entry must include 'icon' (Nerd Font glyph), 'color' (hex), 'cterm_color' (256-color code string), and 'name' (highlight group suffix). Works without strict mode.

options.label: Override by Filename
options.description: Override icons for specific filenames (e.g. '.gitignore', 'Makefile'). Filename matching is case-insensitive. Takes effect when strict mode is enabled.

options.label: Override by Extension
options.description: Override icons for specific file extensions (e.g. 'log', 'txt'). Extension matching is case-sensitive. Takes effect when strict mode is enabled.

options.label: Override by Operating System
options.description: Override icons for operating system identifiers used in file trees and pickers (e.g. 'apple', 'linux', 'windows').

options.label: Override by Desktop Environment
options.description: Override icons for desktop environment names (e.g. 'gnome', 'kde', 'xfce'). Useful for users running Linux desktop environments that are represented in file tree views.

options.label: Override by Window Manager
options.description: Override icons for window manager names (e.g. 'i3', 'hyprland', 'sway'). Useful for users whose file trees display window manager config files.

functions.name: refresh
functions.label: Refresh Icons
functions.description: Re-apply icon color variant and all highlight groups. Call this after changing colorscheme if icons lose their colors.
functions.whatItDoes: Reloads the icon tables for the current light/dark variant and re-applies all DevIcon highlight groups. Useful in startup graphs that switch colorschemes programmatically.

functions.name: get_icon
functions.label: Get Icon
functions.description: Get the icon glyph for a file given its filename and/or extension. Returns the icon character only — the highlight group name returned by the plugin is not captured in the graph.
functions.whatItDoes: Returns the Nerd Font icon character for the given file. The plugin also returns a highlight group name as a second value, but graph nodes capture only the first return value (the icon glyph). Primarily useful when building custom UI components that need to display file icons.

params.name: extension
params.description: File extension without leading dot (e.g. 'lua', 'py'). Used as fallback when filename has no exact match.

functions.name: get_icon_color
functions.label: Get Icon with Color
functions.description: Get the icon glyph for a file. Returns the icon character only — the hex color string returned by the plugin as a second value is not captured in the graph.
functions.whatItDoes: The plugin returns both the icon character and its hex color code (e.g. '#51a0cf'). Graph nodes capture only the first return value (the icon glyph). To use the raw color value, call this function directly in a lua node.

functions.name: get_icon_by_filetype
functions.label: Get Icon by Filetype
functions.description: Get the icon glyph for a Neovim filetype string. Returns the icon character only — the highlight group name returned by the plugin as a second value is not captured in the graph.
functions.whatItDoes: Looks up the icon using Neovim's filetype name (from vim.bo.filetype) rather than a filename. Graph nodes capture only the first return value (the icon glyph). Convenient when you have a buffer's filetype but not a filename.

functions.name: set_default_icon
functions.label: Set Default Icon
functions.description: Override the fallback icon shown when no specific icon is found for a file.
functions.whatItDoes: Changes the default icon glyph and color at runtime. The default is used whenever a file has no matching extension or filename entry and the 'default' option is enabled.

params.name: icon
params.description: Nerd Font glyph character for the default icon

functionTemplates.label: Refresh Icon Highlights
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Re-apply all DevIcon highlight groups after a colorscheme change
functionTemplates.whatItDoes: Useful in a startup graph after loading a colorscheme: add this node after your colorscheme setup to ensure icons always appear with the correct colors.

exCommands.name: NvimWebDeviconsHiTest
exCommands.description: Display all registered icon highlight groups in a scratch buffer. Shows every icon glyph with its assigned color — useful for verifying your Nerd Font is installed correctly and overrides are applied.
